REQUIRED COSMETICS CONSTRAINTS
Keep the supplied cosmetic product's shape, proportions, color, material, cap or pump, logo, printed label and original packaging artwork intact. Show one complete product, without cropping small parts. Do not invent ingredients, efficacy claims, certification marks or packaging details. Preserve any artwork already printed on the real packaging. Do not add advertising copy, prices, badges or watermarks. Preserve existing product label and logo text. Keep palette changes in the scene, never on the product. Reserve the requested copy area for a separate typography renderer.

WATERMARK POLICY — exclude-v1
Always output an image without visible watermarks. Do not add watermarks, stock-photo overlays, creator signatures, platform marks or attribution badges. Remove any watermark overlay from the input photographs rather than copying it into the result. Preserve the real product's printed brand logo, label text and packaging artwork; these are not watermark overlays.

PRODUCT REFERENCES
Image 1 is the primary product and viewpoint. Preserve that view and identity; any additional product images up to image 1 show the same product's details, not extra objects to include. Show exactly one product.
